row: Our goal is to not only rescue animals from high kill shelters, but to help reduce pet overpopulation and increase pet adoptions through campaigns, events, education, spay/neuter programs and rescue partnerships. We believe that by developing strategic alliances with other non-profits and rescue groups, together we can make a greater impact on animal welfare and save more lives. Eastwood Ranch Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-for-profit organization. Visit our Rescue & Adoption Center in Agoura Hills, Ca.
